title: Reading CI output
lead: What a build or a scanner leaves behind, turned into something short enough to read: totals and failures from a report, and the errors that matter from a log thousands of lines long.

title: Writing for the tools
lead: Getting text into the shape an enterprise tool expects before it's sent, so a description, a page or a request arrives the way it was meant.

title: Safety
lead: Checks to run before something leaves the machine or gets trusted: a secret in a diff, a certificate chain that won't validate, a token's claims, and the dependencies a repository ships.

title: Arithmetic models get wrong
lead: Work that looks simple and is easy to get subtly wrong by reasoning alone: time zones and DST, version ordering, encodings and hashes, and how big a file is before reading it. Each one works the answer out, then checks it a second way.
